answer: Forging a thousand sybils means buying a thousand jade bonds plus grinding a thousand work pulses, a cost that scales linearly while legitimate rewards stay fixed. Agents stake a jade token bond to register, and each epoch they must submit a liveness pulse signed with fresh proof-of-work tied to their prior epoch key. Like life on the tundra, only agents that pay real energy per season persist, so cheap identity spam dies and the network stays clean. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
